projects.name: LSM-Tree (WIP)
projects.description: Implementing a Rust-based LSM-Tree storage engine with persistent WAL, MemTables, SSTables, Bloom Filters and compaction, exploring efficient on-disk storage, write amplification, and read/write optimization for distributed systems.

projects.name: Jailer
projects.description: A lightweight container runtime in Rust, implementing Linux namespace isolation (PID, network, mount and UTS), cgroup-based resource limits, filesystem isolation, and Unix domain socket-based daemon communication.

projects.name: R-Raft
projects.description: An implementation of the Raft distributed consensus algorithm in C++, featuring leader election, log replication, persistent WAL, and gRPC-based inter-node communication for fault-tolerant distributed systems.

projects.name: Audio Streaming in C
projects.description: Streams audio from server to client over UDP using a custom protocol, with sockets and multi-threading for communication and added reliability.

projects.name: Packet Sniffer
projects.description: A packet-sniffing utility in C++ using macOS utun (TUN) interfaces to capture and inspect network traffic at the packet level, with ICMP packet capture and analysis.

projects.name: Find The Path Game
projects.description: A game in Java where the player finds the shortest path from source to destination while avoiding walls. The player's score is calculated by comparing their path with Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm.

openSource.name: HolmesGPT (CNCF)
openSource.description: Added configurable webhook alerting for health checks, supporting custom HTTP methods, headers and versioned JSON payloads, and added the --refresh-toolsets flag to refresh toolset status in the ask command.

openSource.name: Tegon.ai (YC S'23)
openSource.description: Added a custom logger and migrated logs from the old logger, and added a Sentry integration to create and link issues from Sentry to Tegon.

openSource.name: Memphis.dev (CNCF)
openSource.description: Added API-key based authentication in the broker, Go SDK and gateway.

openSource.name: Go-functional
openSource.description: Added Go linters, pre-commit hooks and small features.

openSource.name: Other
openSource.description: Small features and bug fixes in mgod and Dice-DB.
